page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance utilizes the KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated compute resources. The hardware configuration establishes a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances.

Given its balanced resource distribution and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.g9i.large is suited for general-purpose workloads. These include lightweight web serving, application microservices, development environments, and small-scale databases that require predictable compute performance but do not demand high storage I/O or GPU acceleration.
